label: AI Insight UI — SPA Fallback
info:
SPA history-mode fallback for the AI Insight UI.

Vue Router uses createWebHistory(BASE_URL) so deep routes like
  /orce/aiInsight/data-products/all
look like real URLs to the server. UIBUILDER's static-file middleware
returns a 404 for any path that isn't a real file under
/data/uibuilder/aiInsight/src/, which breaks F5 / direct-link refresh
on any non-root SPA route.

This flow catches the GET /aiInsight/* requests UIBUILDER's static
middleware didn't claim (Express middleware order: static runs first,
falls through with next() if file not found). It serves the SPA's
index.html from disk so the browser boots the SPA, then Vue Router
resolves the path client-side.

Asset-like paths (anything ending in .ext) get a clean 404 instead
of the HTML — a missing JS bundle should not be served as HTML.

No SPA code change. No ingress change. Tab is independent of the
dispatcher / data-products / etc. flow tabs.
